On 27 Mar, NQ spiked at the 09:30 open to about 18,568 (±3), just above the 18562.75 line, then sold off hard to about 18,381 by about 10:00-10:15 ET. The 15m bar at 10:15 read O18411.50 H18436.25 L18409.75 C18413.75. ES on 5m also dropped after the open, from about 5289 to about 5273, then bounced to 5277-5280 by 10:21. The watchlist showed ES +0.2% and NQ -0.1% on the day.
